integrity: The construction is proved by exact algebraic identities and Hajja's published existence/equiareal criteria. Numerical values are diagnostic only; no independent validation is claimed.
scientific limitations: The result rules out four distinct balloon-radius classes and constructs one three-class edge-incentric 8-simplex with incenter equal to centroid. It does not classify all three-class solutions or prove dimension 8 minimal.
title: Three balloon-radius classes in an edge-incentric 8-simplex and a four-class obstruction
